notes: Observatory 3D: the dome encoder from the zenith photos (it points at the camera) and a new measure camera – dome encoder (17 cm); the filter wheel now has its measured size (Ø 19 cm, was 43 cm).

Download and install without a GitHub account: with the maintainer's update key the update notice has ⬇ Download and install. The zip is checked against its SHA-256 and installed like a zip update; nothing is deleted.

Komeetat (comets) on the sky map: today's bright comets with brightness, position, altitude and motion; C/2026 A2 (Bok) built in, all comets from the Minor Planet Center with one button, or a file without internet.
Comet tracking: the mount follows the comet with tracking rates where the ASCOM driver allows it, otherwise it is re-centred every few minutes between exposures. STOP (Esc) ends it.
Update notice: the program checks once a day whether a newer release is on GitHub and shows what is new. Nothing is downloaded or installed without you.
Your own window layouts by name (the 💾 Layout button next to Mode), and a safe start with the default layout if the previous start did not finish.
Crosshairs in the Capture panel: mouse crosshair with coordinates (X) and centre cross (Shift+X).
Observatory 3D: flat panel position, FLAT and zenith poses, hour angle ±12 h, more measured dimensions and photos placed in the model.
